relocation_side_effect.fix: Separate relocated validation PE and pristine semantic PE; no observed output is injected.

short_thunk.cause: A two-instruction movabs/jmp thunk was decoded as four instructions, including unrelated padding.
short_thunk.fix: Stop at the first JMP; validate the fixed two/four-instruction templates.

capture_boundaries.cause: The initial terminal set included inline decoder entries but omitted wrapper returns to their native callers.
capture_boundaries.treatment: Retain raw frames; reject before Level A/C execution. Add declared static wrapper-return terminals for fresh captures.
